marta (sec): Reports of SCIM 403s after RBAC prune. can we triage?
kevin (idp): saw unwrap failures - encryption_context_mismatch. role_slug normalization changed role_hash.
glen (sre): sample log:
```
2026-06-12T18:05:01Z identity ERROR scim deprov extid=helium|U-77 -> 403
2026-06-12T18:05:01Z identity WARN kms unwrap DecryptionError: encryption_context_mismatch expected={"role_hash":"r_old"} got={"role_hash":"r_new"}
```
marta (sec): impact count?
glen (sre): 5 failed deprovisions across two tenants. queue backed but not outage.
kevin (idp): plan: dry-run rewrap then canary rewrap small batch, pause if >5% errors. tool: `scripts/identity_rewrap --tenant helium --dry-run`
kms-bot: key-check: no key rotation in window.
kevin (idp): canary rewrap done: 5 rewrapped, 0 failures, queues drained. filing IDP-320 to stop including mutable role_hash in KMS context.
